text: Verified audit evidence: SyncEvidence uses a universal two-mark minimum although PRD T-9 requires one mark for offset-only fitting. Signed Span and public case-class results can express negative or incoherent residual and occupancy evidence. TidyCsv.decode returns raw strings after structural checks, so workflow encode/decode equality proves syntax, not semantic reconstitution. Add direct workflow warnings and provenance accessors and rename importedRows to acceptedRows or sourceRows.
